label: Resource Allocation Optimizer
description: Analyzes resource allocation across multiple projects. Identifies over-allocation, under-utilization, and skill mismatches. Recommends reallocation to maximize delivery throughput.

claudeKnowledge.description: Resource management, capacity planning, portfolio resource optimization, skills matrix management

guidedInputs.label: Resource pool
guidedInputs.placeholder:
List your available resources with skills and availability.
e.g.
Name | Role | Skills | Total capacity (days/month)
Anna K. | Senior BA | Business analysis, requirements, AMLR | 22 days
Erik L. | Tech Lead | Java, microservices, AWS, DevOps | 22 days
Sofia M. | QA Engineer | Test automation, Selenium, API testing | 20 days (80%)
Marcus N. | Data Engineer | Python, SQL, dbt, Snowflake | 22 days
Lisa P. | PM | Project management, PRINCE2, stakeholder | 15 days (part-time)

guidedInputs.label: Project resource demands
guidedInputs.placeholder:
List projects and their resource requirements for the planning period.
e.g.
Project Alpha (AMLR Implementation):
- BA: 18 days, Tech Lead: 15 days, QA: 10 days, PM: 8 days

Project Beta (Data Platform):
- Data Engineer: 20 days, Tech Lead: 12 days, QA: 8 days

Project Gamma (Client Portal):
- BA: 10 days, Tech Lead: 10 days, QA: 6 days, PM: 5 days

BAU/operational:
- Tech Lead: 4 days, QA: 3 days

guidedInputs.label: Project priorities
guidedInputs.placeholder:
List projects in priority order and any fixed constraints.
e.g. 1. Alpha (mandatory regulatory deadline Sep 2025), 2. Beta (strategic priority), 3. Gamma (client commitment, can flex timeline by 2 weeks)

guidedInputs.label: Known constraints and commitments
guidedInputs.placeholder:
Any leave, training, conference attendance, or other pre-committed time that reduces availability.
e.g. Erik on annual leave 10-14 March. Lisa attending PMI conference 5-6 March. Sofia: 20% time allocated to Centre of Excellence work.
